items.question: How do I choose the right size?
items.answer: Use the size guide on each product page and compare the measurements with a similar garment you already own.

items.question: Can I return an item that does not fit?
items.answer: Unworn items can be returned within 30 days, with labels attached.

items.question: How should I layer a top for changeable weather?
items.answer: Start with a breathable base layer, add an insulating mid-layer, and carry a shell for wind or rain.

items.question: Can I wear a fleece underneath a waterproof jacket?
items.answer: Yes. Choose your usual size for a base layer or size up if you prefer room for a thick mid-layer.
